en.sayed-ali-raza: Do not let your banner bend down, nor leave it alone.
Do not give it to anyone except the brave and the defenders of honour among you
because they alone endure the befalling of troubles; they surround the banners and encircle them on both sides, their rear and their front.
They do not separate from them lest they give them over (to the enemy). They do not go ahead of them lest they leave them alone.
Everyone should deal with his adversary and also help his comrade by his own life, and should not leave the adversary to his comrade lest both his own adversary and his comrade’s join against him.
